nodes.description: Address of the Governor Guardian allowed to cancel proposals and to appoint a new guardian.
ReputationInterface token used for vote weights, quorum and proposal thresholds.
DAOStack Controller used to route proposal actions through genericCall.
DAOStack Avatar address, execution context and ETH recipient.
INameService registry used to resolve DAO addresses such as CONTROLLER and REPUTATION.
Timestamp after which the foundation loses its guardian veto/guardian-setting power.
Number of blocks a proposal stays open for voting.
Quorum percentage expressed in 1e6 units.
Minimum reputation percentage required to propose (1e6 units).
Maximum number of actions allowed inside a single proposal.
Number of blocks between proposal creation and voting start.
Timelock duration applied once a proposal first reaches quorum.
Shortened timelock applied after absolute majority.
Minimum time that must remain when the vote decision changes during the timelock.
Window after eta during which a succeeded proposal may still be executed.
Total number of proposals created; also used as the proposal id generator.
mapping(uint256 => Proposal) holding the full record of every proposal.
mapping(address => uint256) with the latest proposal id per proposer.
Initializer that wires the DAO, reputation token, guardian and the initial voting parameters.
Public repair function that swaps the guardian only for one hardcoded address.
Public function re-resolving the reputation token from the name service.
Avatar-only entry point forwarding to _setVotingParameters.
Internal parameter setter with anti-doubling checks and zero-means-unchanged semantics.
propose() overload that delegates to the bridge-aware propose with the current chain id.
Main propose implementation storing targets/values/signatures/calldatas and enforcing one live proposal per proposer.
Computes or extends a proposal's execution eta after quorum or a decision change.
Payable executor that runs every action of a succeeded proposal.
Internal helper that performs the actual low-level or DAO-routed call for one action.
Cancels a proposal, callable by the guardian or when the proposer fell below threshold.
View accessor returning a proposal's action data.
View accessor returning a voter's ballot receipt.
Derives the ProposalState from block numbers, timestamps, votes and quorum.
Public vote entry point resolving the voter and its votes from the reputation token.
EIP-712 signature based voting using ecrecover to derive the signatory.
Internal ballot recorder that accumulates for/against votes and triggers eta updates.
Returns the current chain id via assembly.
Guardian-only function renouncing the guardian role and setting the release timestamp to zero.
Sets a new guardian, callable by the avatar or the current guardian, subject to the foundation release timestamp.
Publicly emits a succeeded proposal's details and marks cross-chain proposals executed.
Access check comparing msg.sender with dao.avatar().
Public function re-resolving the controller and avatar from the name service.
UUPS upgrade authorisation hook delegating to _onlyAvatar.
External UUPS upgrade entry point guarded by onlyProxy.
Payable UUPS upgrade plus follow-up delegatecall entry point.
ContextUpgradeable helper returning msg.sender.
msg.sender, the caller controlling voting, proposing, cancelling and guardian operations.
block.timestamp, used for eta computation, proposal state and guardian release gating.
target.call{value: value}(callData) in _executeTransaction, transferring value to an arbitrary proposal target.
dao.genericCall(target, callData, avatar, value) forwards arbitrary calldata through the DAO controller.
payable(address(avatar)).transfer(value) native ETH forwarding before the generic call.
proposalCount++ counter increment used as the next proposal id.
proposal.forVotes += votes, arithmetic accumulation of voter weight.
proposal.againstVotes += votes, arithmetic accumulation of voter weight.
proposal.eta += gameChangerPeriod - timeLeft, timestamp based arithmetic in _updateETA.
ecrecover(digest, v, r, s) signature recovery in castVoteBySig.
target.delegatecall(data) in _functionDelegateCall, executing arbitrary code in the proxy context.
uint256 proposal id parameter of state/execute/cancel/castVote/emitSucceeded.
address[] targets of the actions in a proposal.
uint256[] values to be sent with each action.
string[] function signatures of the actions.
bytes[] calldata payloads of the actions.
Proposal description string used only in the ProposalCreated event.
Chain id the proposal is meant for, enabling cross-chain proposals.
uint256[9] array of new voting parameters.
bool selecting for or against in a ballot.
address whose receipt is being written in _castVote.
uint256 reputation weight attached to a ballot.
uint8 signature recovery id passed to ecrecover.
bytes32 ECDSA signature r value.
bytes32 ECDSA signature s value.
address _guardian assigned in setGuardian.
address newImplementation target of the UUPS upgrade.
block.number + votingDelay, the block voting starts.
startBlock + votingPeriod, the block voting ends.
Cached latest proposal id of the proposer used to enforce one live proposal.
Flag tracking whether the ballot flipped the majority side of a proposal.
eta - block.timestamp remaining before execution in _updateETA.
Encoded selector plus data payload built inside _executeTransaction.
Storage pointer to the newly created Proposal record.
Address recovered from the EIP-712 ballot signature.

edges.reason: _msgSender() simply returns msg.sender, the entry point for all caller-controlled flows.
castVote derives the voter and its reputation weight from msg.sender.
propose uses msg.sender as proposer, for the threshold check and for latestProposalIds.
cancel trusts msg.sender for the guardian bypass of the threshold requirement.
renounceGuardian requires msg.sender to equal the stored guardian.
setGuardian authorises msg.sender when it is the avatar or the current guardian.
_onlyAvatar compares msg.sender against dao.avatar().
setVotingParameters is restricted to the DAO avatar through _onlyAvatar.
_authorizeUpgrade restricts UUPS upgrades to the avatar.
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before mutating the implementation slot.
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before mutating the implementation slot.
The caller-supplied newImplementation becomes the delegatecall target executed in proxy context.
upgradeToAndCall reaches the low-level delegatecall through _upgradeToAndCallSecure and _functionDelegateCall.
execute iterates proposal actions and performs external calls through _executeTransaction.
_executeTransaction performs a low-level call to the proposal target when it equals the DAO controller address.
Any other target is routed through dao.genericCall with the raw calldata.
ETH value is forwarded to the avatar before the generic call is executed.
The DAO genericCall can hand control to arbitrary code able to re-enter execute/state while actions are still running.
The low-level call gives control to a proposal target contract that may re-enter the voting machine.
The native value transfer to the avatar contract happens before the proposal action completes, allowing re-entry.
execute requires state(proposalId) to be Succeeded before running any action.
state compares block.timestamp with proposal.eta and gracePeriod, making execution outcomes timestamp dependent.
state reads the proposal record from the proposals mapping.
_updateETA derives the execution eta from block.timestamp plus queue/fast queue/game changer periods.
The eta extension is computed with timestamp arithmetic.
The extended eta is written back into the stored proposal.
_castVote triggers _updateETA once either side reaches quorum.
_castVote requires the proposal state to be Active or ActiveTimelock.
Voter weight is added into forVotes without any bound.
Voter weight is added into againstVotes without any bound.
Accumulated forVotes is persisted in the proposal record.
Accumulated againstVotes is persisted in the proposal record.
castVoteBySig recovers the ballot signer with ecrecover before casting the vote.
The caller supplied v value is fed into ecrecover.
The caller supplied r value is fed into ecrecover.
The caller supplied s value is fed into ecrecover.
Votes for the recovered signatory are read from the reputation token.
The recovered signatory is passed to _castVote as the voter.
proposalCount++ increments the unbounded proposal id counter.
The incremented proposalCount is used as the key of the new Proposal.
The newProposal storage pointer writes fields into the proposals mapping.
latestProposalId is read from latestProposalIds to enforce the one live proposal rule.
propose populates the latestProposalId local from the caller's stored proposal id.
Proposer supplied targets array is stored in the proposal.
Proposer supplied values array is stored in the proposal.
Proposer supplied signatures array is stored in the proposal.
Proposer supplied calldatas array is stored and later executed.
Description is forwarded to the ProposalCreated event.
forBlockchain tags the proposal and later gates execution.
The short propose overload delegates to the bridge-aware propose implementation.
getChainId is used to mark the proposal's originating chain.
execute requires proposal.forBlockchain to equal the current chain id.
The supplied parameter array is applied in _setVotingParameters.
setVotingParameters is gated by _onlyAvatar before applying new parameters.
_setVotingParameters writes the quorum percentage.
_setVotingParameters writes the voting period.
The new guardian address is attacker/avatar supplied in setGuardian.
proposalId indexes the proposals mapping inside state().
proposalId selects which proposal execute() runs.
proposalId selects which proposal cancel() flags as canceled.
proposalId selects the proposal a voter votes on.
proposalId selects the proposal whose details are emitted.
support decides whether votes go to forVotes or againstVotes.
voter is the key used for the receipt mapping and duplicate vote check.
_castVote computes the hasChanged flag by comparing majorities before and after the ballot.
hasChanged determines whether _updateETA extends the existing eta.
timeLeft drives the game changer extension arithmetic on eta.
callData built from signature plus data is the payload of the low-level call.
Computed startBlock is persisted in the proposal.
Computed endBlock is persisted in the proposal.
foundationGuardianRelease gates who may change the guardian.
block.timestamp is compared with foundationGuardianRelease to authorise guardian changes.
The reputation token supplies totalSupplyAt values used for quorum and threshold checks.
_onlyAvatar reads dao.avatar() to authorise the caller.
updateAvatar resolves the CONTROLLER address from the name service.
updateAvatar stores the resolved controller in dao.

normalization_plan.reason: proposalId is only meaningful as the index consumed by state()/execute()/cancel(); fold it into those core functions.
targets is a raw storage input of propose, later replayed by execute().
values is a raw storage input of propose used when executing actions.
signatures is a raw storage input concatenated into callData at execution time.
calldatas is a raw storage input executed through _executeTransaction.
description is only forwarded to the ProposalCreated event by propose.
forBlockchain tags the proposal and gates execute(), so it belongs to propose.
The parameter array is applied field by field inside _setVotingParameters.
support selects the vote side inside _castVote.
voter is the receipt key written by _castVote.
votes is the weight fed directly into the for/against accumulation arithmetic.
v is a direct argument of the ecrecover call in castVoteBySig.
r is a direct argument of the ecrecover call in castVoteBySig.
s is a direct argument of the ecrecover call in castVoteBySig.
_guardian is the value assigned to the guardian state variable by setGuardian.
newImplementation is the address that ends up being delegatecalled during upgrades.
startBlock is a temporary computed inside propose and written into the proposal.
endBlock is a temporary computed inside propose and written into the proposal.
latestProposalId is a temporary lookup used by propose's one-live-proposal checks.
hasChanged is a temporary majority-flip flag owned by _castVote.
timeLeft is the operand of the eta extension arithmetic.
callData is the payload handed to the low-level call.
newProposal is just a storage pointer used to populate proposals.
signatory is the recovered address used by castVoteBySig to cast the ballot.
